mentions.name: Preloop
mentions.description: Preloop runs unmodified GitHub Actions workflows locally or self-hosted in isolated cross-platform microVMs (built on smolvm, which uses the libkrun VMM). The runner was rewritten and the control plane reverse-engineered to follow the exact official runner protocol; each job runs in a microVM that boots in ~400ms from a packed image. It can pause on every failure so the user or an agent can immediately shell in at that point, fix, and retry in a new environment, and it implements the full DAP protocol for interactively stepping through and investigating context at each step/job.
mentions.problem: GitHub Actions' reliability issues and the inability to run or test workflows locally.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Preloop(https://preloop.dev), a way to run your unmodified Github Actions locally or self-hosted in isolated cross-platform microvms(uses smolvm which uses libkrun vmm).
